presentation.title: Build evidence-grade interface corpora
presentation.body: Spis discovers, captures, verifies, and indexes reference material for product interfaces. Its checked-in catalogs join source identity, real interaction evidence, accessibility observations, and immutable crawl receipts so later design work can trace every claim to the material that supports it.

presentation.title: Choose the command for the evidence boundary
presentation.body: Use `spis crawl` to coordinate durable capture runs, the `crawl-*` commands for their surface-specific execution engines, `docs-corpus` to read imported documentation corpora, and the reference, verification, analysis, image, and catalog commands to maintain checked-in evidence. Run `spis --help` whenever you need the complete command surface.

presentation.title: Read one real catalog validation result
presentation.body: From the Spis repository, run `spis generate-example-catalogs --check`. The command validates every checked-in catalog and prints its complete and partial record counts without modifying catalog files. This walkthrough records success only after those real summaries are produced; then run `spis onboarding` again to finish.
